name: credential-management-system
description: Enterprise Employee Credential Management System - Windows Desktop App
author: Top Tech Developers

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "API,WEB,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter @credential-manager/api dev" "pnpm --filter @credential-manager/web dev" "wait-on -t 30000 http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health && pnpm --filter @credential-manager/desktop dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:desktop
